name: Rising trendline bounce in an uptrend

sections.hypothesis: In an uptrend, when price pulls back to a rising trendline drawn through the two most recent known swing lows and closes back above it, the bounce reaches 3R more often than its cost-adjusted break-even rate (about 26%).
sections.rationale: Trend persistence is one of the better-documented effects in crypto. A rising line through higher lows is the most widely drawn picture of that trend, so buyers may cluster there and make it partly self-fulfilling. Weak point: a line through only two points is somewhat arbitrary, and the third touch is where many trendlines break.
sections.rules: Shared definitions: 4h bars; swing high/low = a bar's high (low) beats the 3 bars each side, known only 3 bars later; ATR = 14-bar average true range at the signal bar. Lines and levels use only swings known at the signal bar. Buy at the next open; risk 1% per trade (spot, no leverage); one position at a time. Uptrend: the two most recent known swing lows are rising and the most recent known swing high is above the one before it. Line: through those two swing lows, projected forward. Touch: a bar whose low comes within 0.25 ATR of the projected line (or below it) and that closes above the line. That close is the signal. Stop: projected line minus 1 ATR at the signal bar. Target: 3R. A close more than 1 ATR below the line ends the trend; a new line needs two new swing lows.
sections.falsification: BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT 4h, 2020-01 to 2025-10 (before the holdout), default parameters, run once. Reject if, pooled across both markets: net expectancy after costs is 0R or below; or P(expectancy > 0) is under 90%; or fewer than 50 trades; or it doesn't beat buying a pullback of the same depth in the same uptrends without the line (entry when the low comes within 1.5 ATR of the most recent swing low, same stop distance and 3R): the line is the claimed edge.
sections.parameters: swing_bars 3 (2-5); touch tolerance 0.25 ATR (0.1-0.5); stop buffer 1 ATR (0.5-2); target 3R (2-4). Only the defaults are pre-registered.
sections.costs: Stops about 1 ATR below the line, so 2-4% on 4h: roughly 0.05-0.1R per round trip. Touches may be more frequent than level retests, perhaps 2-4 a month in trending periods and none in down-trends.

sections.parameters: swing_bars 3 (2-5); touch_atr_pct 25 (10-50); stop_atr_pct 100 (50-200); target_r 3 (2-4). Comparison: swing-pullback with swing_bars 3, pullback_atr_pct 150, stop_atr_pct 100, target_r 3. Only the defaults are pre-registered.

history.reason: Tested (v2) on BTC and ETH 4h: slightly positive but not convincing (P(> 0) 83% against 90% required), and worse than the same trade without the line. Recorded as drop; closed in the 2026-11-14 clean-out.
